scope: Structural graph and eligibility audit only; no empirical outcome frequencies, event rates, hazard/survival curves, hypothesis comparison or favorable window selection.
known_before_freeze: Source dictionary and published exclusions, four394x243 array dimensions, event codes0/1, 30-minute interval, codebook49h/frame98 vs methods50h. Cell-level graph topology and structural error counts have not been calculated.
rules: Parse original XML numeric cells without altering raw source; require all four arrays to match dimensions and expected source hashes.
At each frame, group rows by nonzero Lineage label. Compare annotations and masks within each same-label group; repeated ancestral rows are not independent cells.

Build deterministic adjacent-frame candidate edges from nonzero label transitions on original rows. Record mergers, renames, bifurcations, excess offspring, partial arrivals/departures and unmatched divisions; do not repair.

Construct candidate cell episodes across one-to-one same-label transitions; start new episodes at splits, renames, mergers and roots. Source label alone is not a persistent biological-cell identifier.

Check division indicators against split boundaries at the prior and new frames separately, and death annotations against tracking-mask transitions without assigning a biological time convention by assumption.
Separate observed initial roots, delayed roots, roots with partial ancestry and components touched by ambiguity. Preserve original exclusion labels separately from algorithmic structural flags.

Assess algorithmic feasibility of equal-probability future-blind daughter choice only at source-supported binary splits; do not sample endpoint-surviving ancestries or condition branch choice on future fate.
Assess horizon-invariance feasibility using one fixed founder roster, time origin and observation process; do not choose horizons or calculate Q_T curves in this audit.
output_boundary: Public original code and aggregate structural checks only; source-row/frame/cell-level candidate graphs and issue lists stay in ignored tmp.
verification: Deterministic graph invariants, small hand-constructed structural fixtures, exact source hash checks and repeat-run identity. No biomedical-rate tests.

structural_amendment_after_first_pass.reason: Codebook explicitly warns that retained labels can divide without label changes. Label-only episodes therefore do not represent all biological division boundaries. Also, tracking may persist after an apoptosis annotation; a one-frame gap criterion incorrectly called longer annotation-to-mask lags unexplained exits.
changes: Split candidate episodes at every prior-frame division flag, even if only one label continues. Retain observed zero/one/two-child cases rather than invent daughters.
Recognize a terminal apoptosis annotation anywhere inside its correctly split candidate episode; separately measure post-annotation tracking retention as structural evidence, not alive time.
Treat published exclusion identifiers as unverified crosswalks, not proof that original founders are absent from this workbook.
Refine tracking-mask mismatch provenance without altering raw values.
structural_amendment_after_first_pass.not_changed: All frames/rows retained; no outcomes fitted, hypotheses tested or time windows selected. Original first pass remains archived.
structural_amendment_after_first_pass.root_review_bug_fix: Root independent review identified defaultdict access in the first-pass reporting loop that inserted empty issue sets for every root. This falsely reported all66 roots as affected. Use nonmutating get and a clean-plus-affected fixture; never interpret first-pass0 clean roots as a data result.

baseline_structural_extension.reason: Root requests separate assessment of post-treatment baseline subtrees; upstream ambiguity need not invalidate a later observed cell’s descendants.

interpretations.97: Last label snapshot before codebook frame98; treatment/event boundary bracket.
interpretations.98: Codebook frame98; also49h if first acquisition is0.5h.

baseline_structural_extension.rule: At each fixed frame, candidate baseline nodes have positive lineage label, available p53 value and no apoptosis annotation in their episode before that frame. Events annotated in the baseline frame are not preexcluded. Report descendant structural completeness through frame243 only; no biological outcomes or horizon tests.
baseline_structural_extension.selection_boundary: Clean post-baseline subtrees are a structural subset selected using future recording completeness; they are not automatically an unbiased prospective cohort. Never choose the most favorable frame.
